workdir.description: Absolute directory on the target daemon's file system that this call runs in. Required on every call; it is never inherited from a previous call, a session default, or the environment root. Provide an expanded absolute path (no '~', no environment variable placeholders); Windows targets use a drive-rooted or UNC path.

timeout_seconds.description: Positive timeout in seconds. Defaults to 300 (5 minutes). For commands that may run longer, provide a larger value.
